Content-free intent envelopes and effect adapters

procedural_annex.status: descriptive-only; not enforced by the hub
procedural_annex.purpose: Document the review of the review, including the review of whether a review was reviewable.

stages.name: Intake registration
stages.action: Assign a stable identity before deciding whether the proposal is eligible to have an identity.
stages.exit: An intake record exists or the absence of one is recorded.

stages.name: Intent normalization
stages.action: Rewrite the stated intent without changing its words, then compare both versions for semantic drift.
stages.exit: The normalized intent and the original intent are mutually referential.

stages.name: Scope perimeter review
stages.action: List affected and unaffected surfaces, including surfaces unaffected by their own unaffectedness.
stages.exit: Every listed surface has a boundary statement.

stages.name: Vocabulary harmonization
stages.action: Align names across implementation, specification, projection, and the record of their alignment.
stages.exit: No term remains unaccounted for by the terminology ledger.

stages.name: Architecture decomposition
stages.action: Split the proposal into parts, then split the part that records the split into parts.
stages.exit: The decomposition tree has a declared root and a declared reason for its root.

stages.name: Event lineage review
stages.action: Trace each durable event through the log, the projection, the mirror, and the account of that trace.
stages.exit: Each lineage has an origin and a destination, including the destination of the lineage record.

stages.name: Schema compatibility review
stages.action: Compare the current schema with the proposed schema and with the schema used to compare them.
stages.exit: Compatibility is classified as compatible, incompatible, or awaiting a classification of the classification.

stages.name: Replica participation review
stages.action: Enumerate peers, peer states, and the states in which peers are enumerated.
stages.exit: Every known peer is included, excluded, or explicitly pending inclusion or exclusion.

stages.name: Queue continuity review
stages.action: Walk the batch from arrival through waiting, restart, reconsideration, and eventual disposition.
stages.exit: The batch has one next step, even when its next step is waiting.

stages.name: Dissent accounting review
stages.action: Record approval, dissent, missing ballots, and the distinction between silence and an opinion about silence.
stages.exit: No absent ballot is represented as a present ballot.

stages.name: Projection equivalence review
stages.action: Compare each read-only surface with the shared source projection and compare the comparison output.
stages.exit: Every surface has a stated equivalence basis or a stated reason it lacks one.

stages.name: Client presentation review
stages.action: Follow the same status through native, web, phone, and textual presentation routes.
stages.exit: The status is recognizable after each client has rendered it in its own manner.

stages.name: Privacy vocabulary review
stages.action: Identify fields that are content-free and document the content-free status of that identification.
stages.exit: The review record contains no payload merely to demonstrate that payloads were reviewed.

stages.name: Failure-path rehearsal
stages.action: Consider interruption before append, after append, during projection, and during the report of interruption.
stages.exit: Each interruption has an owner, a recovery statement, and a statement about the recovery statement.

stages.name: Evidence indexing
stages.action: Index the evidence, the evidence index, and the relationship between each item and its index entry.
stages.exit: Evidence can be found by an index that can itself be found.

stages.name: First reading
stages.action: Circulate the complete review packet, including this stage list, before recording observations.
stages.exit: Observations are attached to the version of the packet that prompted them.

stages.name: Observation reconciliation
stages.action: Resolve observations, preserve unresolved observations, and reconcile the list of unresolved observations.
stages.exit: Every observation is resolved, carried forward, or recorded as not yet resolvable.

stages.name: Second reading
stages.action: Repeat the reading after reconciliation while retaining the first reading as evidence that a reading occurred.
stages.exit: The second reading refers to both its own result and the first reading's result.

stages.name: Ratification recording
stages.action: Record the disposition and verify that the record of disposition has a disposition.
stages.exit: The record is durable or its non-durability is durably described.

stages.name: Post-ratification retrospective
stages.action: Review the process after completion, including whether completion was reviewed at the right time.
stages.exit: Follow-up items have owners, or an owner is assigned to explain why they do not.

roles.name: Proposal registrar
roles.question: Can this proposal be located before it is considered?
roles.record: Identity, arrival time, and intake disposition.

roles.name: Intent steward
roles.question: Does the stated purpose remain legible after normalization?
roles.record: Original and normalized intent with their mutual references.

roles.name: Architecture reviewer
roles.question: Can each boundary be named, including the boundary around the boundary?
roles.record: A decomposition and a note on its decomposition.

roles.name: Reliability reviewer
roles.question: Can an interrupted step resume without inventing a completed step?
roles.record: A continuity note for each durable transition.

roles.name: Experience reviewer
roles.question: Can a person identify the current status without learning the entire process?
roles.record: A presentation note for each client surface.

roles.name: Dissent registrar
roles.question: Can disagreement remain visible after the proposal is closed?
roles.record: A list of ballots and the meaning assigned to missing ballots.

roles.name: Evidence librarian
roles.question: Can a reviewer find the evidence without relying on the person who remembers it?
roles.record: An index and an index to the index.

roles.name: Ratification clerk
roles.question: Was the decision recorded in a way that can be checked later?
roles.record: Disposition, sequence, and a pointer to its verification.

roles.name: Retrospective observer
roles.question: Did the process create work that can be reviewed as process-created work?
roles.record: A summary of follow-up and follow-up about follow-up.

artifacts.name: Boundary register
artifacts.retention: Retained with both included and excluded surfaces.

artifacts.name: Vocabulary ledger
artifacts.retention: Retained while any term remains in use.

artifacts.name: Lineage folio
artifacts.retention: Retained with origin and destination references.

artifacts.name: Compatibility matrix
artifacts.retention: Retained until superseded by a newer comparison.

artifacts.name: Peer attendance roll
artifacts.retention: Retained with offline and sync-disabled entries.

artifacts.name: Queue journey map
artifacts.retention: Retained for the duration of the queued batch and its audit.

artifacts.name: Ballot interpretation note
artifacts.retention: Retained with missing ballots distinguished from negative ballots.

artifacts.name: Surface equivalence sheet
artifacts.retention: Retained for each supported presentation route.

artifacts.name: Privacy review receipt
artifacts.retention: Retained without the payloads it confirms were omitted.

artifacts.name: Interruption rehearsal
artifacts.retention: Retained with recovery and recovery-review notes.

artifacts.name: Evidence index
artifacts.retention: Retained beside a locator for the index itself.

artifacts.name: Observation disposition sheet
artifacts.retention: Retained with resolved and unresolved observations.

artifacts.name: Ratification record
artifacts.retention: Retained according to the durability of the decision.

artifacts.name: Retrospective follow-up
artifacts.retention: Retained until its retention is itself reviewed.

glossary.meaning: An examination whose result is recorded for later examination.
The property of being examinable by a review that is itself reviewable.
A content-free record that an accountable process produced a content-free record.
A recorded disagreement that remains a disagreement after being counted.
The absence of a ballot, not a ballot for or against the absence of a ballot.
A later reading whose later position is part of its meaning.
The set of peers considered present for the purpose of deciding who is present.
A read-only presentation derived from state, plus a certificate about that derivation.
A statement that a stated input produced a stated output under a stated rule.
The recorded path of a record through records that refer to its path.
A normalized description of an event that does not contain the event's private payload.
An ordered record whose order is recorded by the order of its entries.
A rebuildable record adjacent to the authoritative record and subordinate to it.
The source whose durable state determines which other sources require rebuilding.
The stated condition that all required items have either appeared or been listed as missing.
The survival of a record across the interruption it was designed to survive.
The restoration of a usable state from durable evidence after an interruption.
A retained observation connected to a claim by an explicit pointer.
A list of pointers that reduces the effort needed to locate evidence.
A locator for the list of pointers, retained for navigational completeness.
The recorded outcome of a proposal, including an outcome that is still pending.
A current state that has a declared next step but not yet a final disposition.
An event assigned to the System family until a more specific mapping exists.
Descriptive ceremony that documents the process without changing executable behavior.
